																The above Sections / Tests except the Test of English Language will be available bilingually, i.e. English and Hindi. There will be separate timing for every section. 
																The minimum qualifying marks/percentage of marks in each of the section would be 40% for General & EWS Category and 35% for Reserved Categories. However, the Bank reserves the right to change the minimum/ waive off qualifying criteria at its sole discretion.
																Cumulative marks of Section 1,2,3 and 4 shall be reckoned for drawing the merit list shortlisting the candidates for participation in further selection process and drawing the rank list. There will be penalty for wrong answers in all sections. For each question for which a wrong answer has been given by the candidate, 1/4  or 0.25 of the marks assigned to that question will be deducted as penalty to arrive at corrected score. If a question is left blank, i.e. no answer is given by the candidate; there will be no penalty for that question.
															
															
														
														
															
															BOB LBO 2026: Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																
																Pay Scale: Junior Management Grade Scale-I -Rs.48480- 2000/7- 62480- 2340/2- 67160- 2680/7- 85920/- 
																
																
																Mode of Selection: The selection process comprise of online test, psychometric test or any other test deemed suitable for further selection process followed by Group Discussion and/or Interview of candidates, qualifying in the online test.
																
																
																However, if the number of eligible applications received is large/less, then Bank reserves the right to change the shortlisting criteria/interview process. Bank may, at its discretion, consider conducting of Multiple Choice/Descriptive/ Psychometric Test / Group Discussion/Interviews or any other selection/shortlisting methodologies for the above position.
																
																
																Merely satisfying the eligibility norms does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. Bank reserves the right to call only the requisite number
																of candidates for the interview after preliminary screening/short-listing with reference to the candidate’s qualification, suitability, experience etc.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															BOB LBO 2026: Required Documents for Upload

															
																Resume (PDF)
																Date of Birth Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)
																Educational Certificates: Relevant Mark-Sheets/Certificate (PDF). Please scan ALL your educational certificates into a single PDF file.
																Work Experience Certificates (PDF) (if applicable)
																Caste/Category Certificate (PDF) (if applicable)
																PWD (Persons with Disability) Certificate (PDF) (if applicable)
																Ex-servicemen Discharge Certificate/NOC (PDF) (if applicable)
																Left Thumb Impression & Handwritten Declaration (PDF)
															

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.
																Clarity: Please ensure that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
															

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

	📋 How to Apply for BOB Local Bank Officer LBO Recruitment 2026

	
		Visit the official website of Bank of Baroda www.bankofbaroda.in or bankofbaroda.bank.in.
		Go to the Careers section and click on Current Opportunities.
		Find the notification titled “Recruitment of Local Bank Officer (LBO) on Regular Basis – Advt. No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/16” and click on Apply Now.
		Click on New Registration and enter your basic details (Name, Mobile Number & Email ID) to generate Registration Number and Password.
		Log in using your Registration Number and Password.
		Fill the online application form carefully with personal, educational, experience and other required details.
		Upload scanned photograph, signature and other documents as per the prescribed specifications.
		Pay the application fee online (₹850 for General/EWS/OBC & ₹175 for SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/Women) through available payment modes.
		Review all details carefully and click on Final Submit.
		Download and take a printout of the submitted application form and fee receipt for future reference.
	

	Note: Online application starts from 18 August 2026 and last date to apply & pay fee is 07 September 2026. Candidates can apply for only one state. Keep the registered mobile number and email ID active throughout the recruitment process.

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.

															BOB LBO 2026: Required Documents for Upload

															
																Resume (PDF)
																Date of Birth Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)
																Educational Certificates: Relevant Mark-Sheets/Certificate (PDF). Please scan ALL your educational certificates into a single PDF file.
																Work Experience Certificates (PDF) (if applicable)
																Caste/Category Certificate (PDF) (if applicable)
																PWD (Persons with Disability) Certificate (PDF) (if applicable)

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.
																Clarity: Please ensure that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
															

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

	📋 How to Apply for BOB Local Bank Officer LBO Recruitment 2026

	
		Visit the official website of Bank of Baroda www.bankofbaroda.in or bankofbaroda.bank.in.
		Go to the Careers section and click on Current Opportunities.
		Find the notification titled “Recruitment of Local Bank Officer (LBO) on Regular Basis – Advt. No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/16” and click on Apply Now.

															BOB LBO 2026: Required Documents for Upload

															
																Resume (PDF)
																Date of Birth Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)
																Educational Certificates: Relevant Mark-Sheets/Certificate (PDF). Please scan ALL your educational certificates into a single PDF file.

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.
																Clarity: Please ensure that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
															

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

																Resume (PDF)
																Date of Birth Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.
																Clarity: Please ensure that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
															

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

	📋 How to Apply for BOB Local Bank Officer LBO Recruitment 2026

	
		Visit the official website of Bank of Baroda www.bankofbaroda.in or bankofbaroda.bank.in.

															BOB LBO 2026: Required Documents for Upload

															
																Resume (PDF)
																Date of Birth Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)
																Educational Certificates: Relevant Mark-Sheets/Certificate (PDF). Please scan ALL your educational certificates into a single PDF file.

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.
																Clarity: Please ensure that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
															

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

	📋 How to Apply for BOB Local Bank Officer LBO Recruitment 2026

	
		Visit the official website of Bank of Baroda www.bankofbaroda.in or bankofbaroda.bank.in.

																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.

																Using a Mobile Phone:

																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.

																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

																Resume (PDF)
																Date of Birth Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

															Don'ts:

															BOB LBO 2026: Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

																of candidates for the interview after preliminary screening/short-listing with reference to the candidate’s qualification, suitability, experience etc.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															BOB LBO 2026: Required Documents for Upload

															
																Resume (PDF)
																Date of Birth Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)
																Educational Certificates: Relevant Mark-Sheets/Certificate (PDF). Please scan ALL your educational certificates into a single PDF file.
																Work Experience Certificates (PDF) (if applicable)
																Caste/Category Certificate (PDF) (if applicable)
																PWD (Persons with Disability) Certificate (PDF) (if applicable)
																Ex-servicemen Discharge Certificate/NOC (PDF) (if applicable)
																Left Thumb Impression & Handwritten Declaration (PDF)
															

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.
																Clarity: Please ensure that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
															

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

																Pay Scale: Junior Management Grade Scale-I -Rs.48480- 2000/7- 62480- 2340/2- 67160- 2680/7- 85920/-

															BOB LBO 2026: Required Documents for Upload

															
																Resume (PDF)
																Date of Birth Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)
																Educational Certificates: Relevant Mark-Sheets/Certificate (PDF). Please scan ALL your educational certificates into a single PDF file.
																Work Experience Certificates (PDF) (if applicable)
																Caste/Category Certificate (PDF) (if applicable)
																PWD (Persons with Disability) Certificate (PDF) (if applicable)
																Ex-servicemen Discharge Certificate/NOC (PDF) (if applicable)

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.
																Clarity: Please ensure that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
															

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

	📋 How to Apply for BOB Local Bank Officer LBO Recruitment 2026

	
		Visit the official website of Bank of Baroda www.bankofbaroda.in or bankofbaroda.bank.in.
		Go to the Careers section and click on Current Opportunities.
		Find the notification titled “Recruitment of Local Bank Officer (LBO) on Regular Basis – Advt. No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/16” and click on Apply Now.
		Click on New Registration and enter your basic details (Name, Mobile Number & Email ID) to generate Registration Number and Password.
		Log in using your Registration Number and Password.
		Fill the online application form carefully with personal, educational, experience and other required details.
		Upload scanned photograph, signature and other documents as per the prescribed specifications.
		Pay the application fee online (₹850 for General/EWS/OBC & ₹175 for SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/Women) through available payment modes.
		Review all details carefully and click on Final Submit.
		Download and take a printout of the submitted application form and fee receipt for future reference.
	

	Note: Online application starts from 18 August 2026 and last date to apply & pay fee is 07 September 2026. Candidates can apply for only one state. Keep the registered mobile number and email ID active throughout the recruitment process.

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.
																Clarity: Please ensure that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
															

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

	📋 How to Apply for BOB Local Bank Officer LBO Recruitment 2026

	
		Visit the official website of Bank of Baroda www.bankofbaroda.in or bankofbaroda.bank.in.
		Go to the Careers section and click on Current Opportunities.
		Find the notification titled “Recruitment of Local Bank Officer (LBO) on Regular Basis – Advt. No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/16” and click on Apply Now.
		Click on New Registration and enter your basic details (Name, Mobile Number & Email ID) to generate Registration Number and Password.
		Log in using your Registration Number and Password.
		Fill the online application form carefully with personal, educational, experience and other required details.
		Upload scanned photograph, signature and other documents as per the prescribed specifications.
		Pay the application fee online (₹850 for General/EWS/OBC & ₹175 for SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/Women) through available payment modes.
		Review all details carefully and click on Final Submit.
		Download and take a printout of the submitted application form and fee receipt for future reference.
	

	Note: Online application starts from 18 August 2026 and last date to apply & pay fee is 07 September 2026. Candidates can apply for only one state. Keep the registered mobile number and email ID active throughout the recruitment process.

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

															BOB LBO 2026: Required Documents for Upload

															
																Resume (PDF)
																Date of Birth Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.
																Clarity: Please ensure that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
															

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

															BOB LBO 2026: Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

															
																
																Pay Scale: Junior Management Grade Scale-I -Rs.48480- 2000/7- 62480- 2340/2- 67160- 2680/7- 85920/-

																of candidates for the interview after preliminary screening/short-listing with reference to the candidate’s qualification, suitability, experience etc.
																
															
															
														
														
															
															BOB LBO 2026: Required Documents for Upload

															
																Resume (PDF)
																Date of Birth Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)
																Educational Certificates: Relevant Mark-Sheets/Certificate (PDF). Please scan ALL your educational certificates into a single PDF file.
																Work Experience Certificates (PDF) (if applicable)
																Caste/Category Certificate (PDF) (if applicable)
																PWD (Persons with Disability) Certificate (PDF) (if applicable)
																Ex-servicemen Discharge Certificate/NOC (PDF) (if applicable)
																Left Thumb Impression & Handwritten Declaration (PDF)
															

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.
																Clarity: Please ensure that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
															

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

	📋 How to Apply for BOB Local Bank Officer LBO Recruitment 2026

	
		Visit the official website of Bank of Baroda www.bankofbaroda.in or bankofbaroda.bank.in.
		Go to the Careers section and click on Current Opportunities.
		Find the notification titled “Recruitment of Local Bank Officer (LBO) on Regular Basis – Advt. No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/16” and click on Apply Now.

		Fill the online application form carefully with personal, educational, experience and other required details.

															BOB LBO 2026: Required Documents for Upload

															
																Resume (PDF)
																Date of Birth Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)
																Educational Certificates: Relevant Mark-Sheets/Certificate (PDF). Please scan ALL your educational certificates into a single PDF file.

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.
																Clarity: Please ensure that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
															

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

	📋 How to Apply for BOB Local Bank Officer LBO Recruitment 2026

	
		Visit the official website of Bank of Baroda www.bankofbaroda.in or bankofbaroda.bank.in.
		Go to the Careers section and click on Current Opportunities.
		Find the notification titled “Recruitment of Local Bank Officer (LBO) on Regular Basis – Advt. No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/16” and click on Apply Now.
		Click on New Registration and enter your basic details (Name, Mobile Number & Email ID) to generate Registration Number and Password.
		Log in using your Registration Number and Password.
		Fill the online application form carefully with personal, educational, experience and other required details.
		Upload scanned photograph, signature and other documents as per the prescribed specifications.
		Pay the application fee online (₹850 for General/EWS/OBC & ₹175 for SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/Women) through available payment modes.
		Review all details carefully and click on Final Submit.
		Download and take a printout of the submitted application form and fee receipt for future reference.
	

	Note: Online application starts from 18 August 2026 and last date to apply & pay fee is 07 September 2026. Candidates can apply for only one state. Keep the registered mobile number and email ID active throughout the recruitment process.

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

															BOB LBO 2026: Required Documents for Upload

															
																Resume (PDF)
																Date of Birth Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)
																Educational Certificates: Relevant Mark-Sheets/Certificate (PDF). Please scan ALL your educational certificates into a single PDF file.
																Work Experience Certificates (PDF) (if applicable)
																Caste/Category Certificate (PDF) (if applicable)
																PWD (Persons with Disability) Certificate (PDF) (if applicable)
																Ex-servicemen Discharge Certificate/NOC (PDF) (if applicable)
																Left Thumb Impression & Handwritten Declaration (PDF)
															

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.
																Clarity: Please ensure that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
															

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

	📋 How to Apply for BOB Local Bank Officer LBO Recruitment 2026

	
		Visit the official website of Bank of Baroda www.bankofbaroda.in or bankofbaroda.bank.in.
		Go to the Careers section and click on Current Opportunities.
		Find the notification titled “Recruitment of Local Bank Officer (LBO) on Regular Basis – Advt. No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/16” and click on Apply Now.
		Click on New Registration and enter your basic details (Name, Mobile Number & Email ID) to generate Registration Number and Password.
		Log in using your Registration Number and Password.
		Fill the online application form carefully with personal, educational, experience and other required details.
		Upload scanned photograph, signature and other documents as per the prescribed specifications.
		Pay the application fee online (₹850 for General/EWS/OBC & ₹175 for SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/Women) through available payment modes.
		Review all details carefully and click on Final Submit.
		Download and take a printout of the submitted application form and fee receipt for future reference.
	

	Note: Online application starts from 18 August 2026 and last date to apply & pay fee is 07 September 2026. Candidates can apply for only one state. Keep the registered mobile number and email ID active throughout the recruitment process.

															BOB LBO 2026: Required Documents for Upload

															
																Resume (PDF)
																Date of Birth Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)
																Educational Certificates: Relevant Mark-Sheets/Certificate (PDF). Please scan ALL your educational certificates into a single PDF file.
																Work Experience Certificates (PDF) (if applicable)
																Caste/Category Certificate (PDF) (if applicable)
																PWD (Persons with Disability) Certificate (PDF) (if applicable)

																Left Thumb Impression & Handwritten Declaration (PDF)
															

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.
																Clarity: Please ensure that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
															

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

															BOB LBO 2026: Required Documents for Upload

															
																Resume (PDF)
																Date of Birth Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)
																Educational Certificates: Relevant Mark-Sheets/Certificate (PDF). Please scan ALL your educational certificates into a single PDF file.
																Work Experience Certificates (PDF) (if applicable)

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.
																Clarity: Please ensure that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
															

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.
																Clarity: Please ensure that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
															

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

															BOB LBO 2026: Required Documents for Upload

															
																Resume (PDF)
																Date of Birth Proof: 10th marksheet/certificate (PDF)
																Educational Certificates: Relevant Mark-Sheets/Certificate (PDF). Please scan ALL your educational certificates into a single PDF file.
																Work Experience Certificates (PDF) (if applicable)

															Important Specifications for Uploading:

															Before applying online, make sure you have scanned (digital) images of all the above documents according to these specifications:

															
																Format: All documents must be in PDF format.
																Page Size: The document page size should be A4.
																File Size Limit: The size of each PDF file should not exceed 500 KB.
																Scanning Tips: If you are scanning documents, ensure they are saved as PDFs and their size is not more than 500 KB. If a file is larger than 500 KB, adjust your scanner settings (like DPI resolution, number of colors, etc.) during the scanning process to reduce the file size.
																Clarity: Please ensure that all uploaded documents are clear and readable.
															

															How to Capture Your Live Photo:

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.

															
																
																Using a Webcam:

																
																	
																	Select the "Capture Photo" option.
																	
																	
																	Your webcam will turn on, allowing you to take your picture.
																	
																	
																	The picture will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
																
																Using a Mobile Phone:

																
																	
																	Select the "Click here to Scan" option.
																	
																	
																	Scan the QR code displayed on your screen with your mobile phone.
																	
																	
																	This will open a website on your phone, where you can take your picture.
																	
																	
																	After taking the picture and selecting it, it will automatically be uploaded to your application form.
																	
																
																
															

															Do's and Don'ts for Photo Capture:

															Do's:

															
																
																Make sure your photo is taken against a light-colored, preferably white background, with good lighting.
																
																
																Look straight at the webcam/camera.
																
																
																The photograph should be passport-sized.
																
															

															Don'ts:

															
																
																Do not click or upload a small-sized photograph.
																
																
																Do not wear colored glasses, sunglasses, or a cap.
																
																
																Avoid shadows on your face, not facing the camera, a distorted face, a face covered with a mask, or a blurred image.
																
																
																Do not take the photo in a dark or improper background.

	📋 How to Apply for BOB Local Bank Officer LBO Recruitment 2026

	
		Visit the official website of Bank of Baroda www.bankofbaroda.in or bankofbaroda.bank.in.

		Find the notification titled “Recruitment of Local Bank Officer (LBO) on Regular Basis – Advt. No. BOB/HRM/REC/ADVT/2026/16” and click on Apply Now.

															You will need to capture and upload a live photograph using either a webcam or your mobile phone.
